theme_strategy: Light theme default. Clean, precise Swiss Modern approach. Calm defaults with ranked attention. Dark mode toggle supported.

headings.rules: Use radical weight contrast. Tight tracking for h1/h2 (tracking-tight). Avoid generic 'Inter' for headings.

body.rules: Highly legible, professional, clean reading suitable for dense financial data.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders style. 1px solid borders. No soft or muddy shadows. Content density must be high but distinctly organized.
visual_enhancers.spacing: Generous Spacing inside components. Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards.

components.buttons: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-md). High contrast solid primary or strict outline. Hover states must shift color explicitly.
components.cards: Subtle Neumorphism mixed with Grid Borders. Max 8px border-radius.
components.kanban: Clear column separation with visible borders. Cards must be draggable, tight padding, distinct status badges.
components.forms: shadcn/ui form elements. Clear labeling above inputs.
components.table: High density, clear horizontal borders. Avoid zebra striping; use hover row highlights instead.
components.tabs: Minimalist underline style or pill style. Must not feel cluttered.

grids_layouts.dashboard: High-density Grid. Base: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-4. Summary KPIs top (col-span-1 each), main charts middle (col-span-2 or 3), recent activity feed side (col-span-1 row-span-2).
grids_layouts.client_detail: Sidebar-main layout. col-span-3 for profile summary (left), col-span-9 for deep dive tabs (right: Infos, RDV, Notes, Documents).
grids_layouts.kanban_board: Horizontal scroll flex container with fixed width columns (min-w-[300px]).

motion.interactions: Crisp and fast. hover:-translate-y-[1px] transition-transform duration-200.
motion.transitions: Page loads with subtle fade-in and slide-up. Kanban drag feels solid, not bouncy.

accessibility.contrast: APCA standards required. High contrast text.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent focus:outline-none) on all inputs/buttons.
accessibility.testing: All interactive/key elements MUST include data-testid attribute (kebab-case, role-based).

images.description: Modern Swiss architecture image for the Google login page background.

3d_libraries.usage: Not recommended for this CRM. Keep it 2D and highly readable with Recharts for data visualization.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard using React, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui components.
The UI language MUST be French (e.g., 'Nouveau dossier', 'Rendez-vous', 'Rechercher un client', 'Se connecter avec Google').
Implement a Google Sign-in screen featuring the provided login_background image on one half of the screen.
Implement a Sidebar Navigation for global routing (Tableau de bord, Clients, Agenda, Documents).
Implement the Dashboard with KPI cards, Recharts graphs for monthly stats, and a Kanban board for case statuses.
Implement a comprehensive Client Detail page with tabs for personal/professional info, RDV history, internal notes, and document management.
Implement a Global Search bar in the header.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds in headers, modals, or dropdowns. Use solid or heavily blurred (glassmorphism with 1px border) backgrounds.
Avoid generic 'Inter' font for headings; implement Chivo for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Avoid generic centered layouts. Prioritize asymmetric, highly organized grid layouts (Swiss design). Create depth with 1px borders and very subtle shadows, avoiding muddy drop shadows. Every interaction needs micro-animations (e.g., color shift on hover). NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters. Ensure strict adherence to contrast rules.
